decisions.reason: The same-message INTRODUCE already records the four policy destinations and their footer-menu entry point, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The footer content does not change the Cognito page's branding, background, or required header logo; the possible footer inclusion is tentative and owned by the shared footer Requirement.
The informational-page shell remains defined by its background and header logo. The shared footer's detailed content should not be duplicated into this Requirement.
Adding links to the footer does not alter the existing decision that the landing-page header menu is disabled.
A proposed solid brand-color footer background does not change the shared website page theme or its dark-theme requirement.
The footer's organization, navigation, social, and copyright content does not modify the landing page's established visual direction.
The footer specification does not alter the landing page's section order, How It Works content, or copy plan.
The source specifies the public website footer, not the independently scoped admin-workspace shell footer.
The tentative suggestion to use a SignalCadence brand color does not change the required token-sheet fields or establish a new concrete token value.
The footer content and layout specification does not revise the reusable responsive breakpoint guidance.
The footer design change does not alter the plain HTML and Tailwind CSS build stack.
The footer specification does not change the hero text-emphasis requirement.
